headline: Critical flaws in web and Java infrastructure software: NGINX, Roller, Java4Shell, Drupal, PHP
label: CONFIRMED
latest: Patches published; exploitation reported for Roller and attempts for Java4Shell.

log.text: F5/NGINX, Apache, OpenJDK vendors, Drupal and PHP each published fixes; public PoCs reported for NGINX and Roller.

headline: US AI chip export curbs and Chinese response
label: CONFIRMED
latest: US interim licensing rule; Tencent and Alibaba say they are affected; Alibaba says it trains on in-house chips.

log.text: Rule reported; Alibaba and Tencent comment on impact.

headline: European Commission AI-assisted cyberattack
label: CONFIRMED
